title: Galleria Borghese
visualBrief: Galleria Borghese complete mapped connected villa exterior: pale plaster and limestone trim, five genuinely open round-arch loggia bays with recessed gates, raised terrace and paired outward-descending entrance flights, recessed central three-storey block, lower side wings, broad rear range and two tall square rear towers under terracotta hip roofs. Repeated tall windows, substantial cornices, simplified niches/medallions and balustrades convey the photographed identity. Neighboring park structures remain independent; no copied sculpture, inscriptions, art collections or interiors.
